item.description:
Saved usage on your desktop

Add SubFuse Beta → Saved usage from the macOS widget gallery. The small widget shows the subscription most in need of attention. Medium and large list more subscriptions from your active profile. Click a subscription to open its details.

Remaining usage, freshness dots, and reset labels use readings already saved on your Mac. The widget makes no provider requests.

The widget needs access to shared storage. If macOS withholds access for this ad hoc beta, open SubFuse to see your readings. The app continues using Application Support and retains the original file as a backup after a successful migration.
